caption: The drawing depicts a bronze or brass-colored bell-shaped object mounted on a dark, rectangular base. The bell has a somewhat glossy metallic appearance with shading that emphasizes its three-dimensional form. At the top, there are two parallel raised handles. Encircling the upper part of the bell are the words "CENTENNIAL" in raised letters. Below that, in two lines, it reads "HONEY 1876 BANK," with the year "1876" being the most prominent and largest text. Around the bottom edge of the bell, the inscription "PAT. APR. 13" is visible. The surface of the base is dark with a lighter rim, and the background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Centennial Bank - 1876
